note.tet: Gravasaun instrumentál: inu kompletu dala ida — refraun dala rua no estrofe. Liña ne'ebé atu hananu nakroman tuir múzika: hananu hamutuk! Testu ofisiál mak portugés; tradusaun Tetun no Inglés husi Governu Timór-Leste; tradusaun Indonézia husi Lafa (la ofisiál).
note.pt: Gravação instrumental: o hino completo uma vez — o refrão duas vezes e a estrofe. A linha a cantar acende-se com a música: cante connosco! O texto oficial é o português; traduções em tétum e inglês do Governo de Timor-Leste; tradução indonésia do Lafa (não oficial).
note.en: Instrumental recording: the whole anthem once — the refrain twice and the verse. The line to sing lights up with the music: sing along! The official text is in Portuguese; Tetun and English translations from the Government of Timor-Leste; Indonesian translation by Lafa (unofficial).
note.id: Rekaman instrumental: lagu kebangsaan lengkap satu kali — refrein dua kali dan bait. Baris yang dinyanyikan menyala mengikuti musik: bernyanyilah bersama! Teks resminya berbahasa Portugis; terjemahan Tetun dan Inggris dari Pemerintah Timor-Leste; terjemahan Indonesia oleh Lafa (tidak resmi).

timing.method: Lafa, 2026-11-11: refrain matched by chroma DTW (a whole tone lower) to the Government's vocal recording, whose line times were measured with Whisper; verse from beat tracking and chords — its music is played twice (34 beats each), one line per two-bar phrase, cadences on F and B♭. See tools/anthem/README.md. Check by ear.
